title: Web Design Engineer
description:
A World-Changing Company
 
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.


The Role
 The Palantir Communications Team is at the core of helping Palantir share our mission and products with the world. You will contribute to all aspects of our website’s frontend design, content model, marketing software integration, and CI/CD publishing pipeline. You will act on your design instincts to help build the Palantir brand, while working across the business to bring different parts of the organization’s story forward. Our website is intended to be dynamic, showcasing our diverse technological reach into a variety of different industries. It is updated often with news of our products and successes, and our CEO frequently communicates with customers and shareholders via the website. 

You will work with TypeScript and React, creating the fundamental design principles to help individuals around the company craft frontend experiences which tell their story. Along with creating, you will advise designers and content creators on best web, UX, accessibility and SEO practices. You will work alongside leadership to create and maintain Next.js microsites, starting with mocks, and bringing them through development.

Palantir frequently finds itself a target of external threats, owing to the nature of our business. For that reason, our website publication pipeline has strong controls around access and review. You will need the necessary technical skills and creativity to build a site that is both elegant and secure.

Core Responsibilities
Develop and maintain Palantir.com Build and ship Next.js microsites, from mocks through to production Establish and maintain the design system and shared components other content creators build on Advise designers and content creators on web, UX, accessibility, and SEO best practices Iterate with our Legal team on ongoing requirements as laws and the web evolve Work with the rest of the Communications team to drive traffic with brand campaigns Develop, review, and ship within our CI pipeline, maintaining its threat model as risks evolve
Technologies We Use
TypeScript and React with Next.js for frontend development A combination of open-source and internal technologies that suit the problems at hand Fast content delivery Industry-standard build tooling, including GitHub and CircleCI
What We Value
Eye for detail : part of the role is making sure the content being brought forward cleanly aligns with other content on the website Design sensibility : keeping every web touchpoint of the brand coherent and well presented Cross-functional communication : working across the whole business bringing other teams' stories forward; the ability to translate between non-technical stakeholders and implementation matters Juggling priorities : ability to move several projects forward at once without dropping quality on any of them Ownership : this role carries a lot of independence, and with it responsibility for the outcomes that independence produces A drive to raise the level around you : teaching teammates and building things others can run with
What We Require
2 Years of experience with frontend design Web fundamentals : accessibility, performance, uptime, SEO Frontend proficiency : TypeScript, React, Next.js Design/visual competence : Figma fluency, ability to take mocks to production
Salary
The salary range for this position is estimated to be $70,000 - $120,000/year. Total compensation for this position may also include Restricted Stock units, sign-on bonus and other potential future incentives. Further note that total compensation for this position will be determined by each individual’s relevant qualifications, work experience, skills, and other factors. This estimate excludes the value of any potential sign-on bonus; the value of any benefits offered; and the potential future value of any long-term incentives.


Our benefits aim to promote health and wellbeing across all areas of Palantirians’ lives. We work to continuously improve our offerings and listen to our community as we design and update them. The list below details our available benefits and some of the perks that can be enjoyed as an employee of Palantir Technologies.
 
Benefits
 
•  Employees (and their eligible dependents) can enroll in medical, dental, and vision insurance as well as voluntary life insurance
•  Employees are automatically covered by Palantir’s basic life, AD&D and disability insurance
•  Commuter benefits
•  Take what you need paid time off, not accrual based
•  2 weeks paid time off built into the end of each year (subject to team and business needs)
•  10 paid holidays throughout the calendar year
•  Supportive leave of absence program including time off for military service and medical events
•  Paid leave for new parents and subsidized back-up care for all parents
•  Fertility and family building benefits including but not limited to adoption, surrogacy, and preservation
•  Stipend to help with expenses that come with a new child
•  Employees can enroll in Palantir’s 401k plan
 
Life at Palantir
 
We want every Palantirian to achieve their best outcomes, that’s why we celebrate individuals’ strengths, skills, and interests, from your first interview to your longterm growth, rather than rely on traditional career ladders. Paying attention to the needs of our community enables us to optimize our opportunities to grow and helps ensure many pathways to success at Palantir. Promoting health and well-being across all areas of Palantirians’ lives is just one of the ways we’re investing in our community. Learn more at Life at Palantir and note that our offerings may vary by region.
